paragraph_edits.before: 一笔加班费能否让生活过得更好，不能只看到账金额。同样是增加收入，有人延长白天工作，有人连续上夜班，也有人借助 AI 提高效率。三种安排对睡眠、精力和家庭时间的影响可能不同。比较应从具体生活出发：钱增加了多少，时间用在何处，第二天还能否正常工作、学习或照顾家人。图 1 将这些问题组织为共同框架，图 2 区分其中的测量、预测与评价。
paragraph_edits.after: 一笔加班费能否改善生活，要看收入增加了多少，也要看付出了什么。延长白天工作、连续上夜班和借助 AI 提高效率，都可能增加收入，却可能给睡眠、精力和家庭时间带来不同影响。比较从具体问题开始：钱增加了多少，时间花在何处，第二天还能否正常工作、学习或照顾家人。图 1 将这些问题纳入同一框架，图 2 区分测量、预测与评价。

paragraph_edits.before: Whether overtime pay improves life cannot be judged from the payment alone. Extra income may come from longer daytime work, repeated night shifts or greater efficiency with AI. These arrangements may differ in their implications for sleep, energy and family time. Comparison starts with concrete questions: how much money is gained, where time goes, and whether the person can work, study or care for family the next day. Figure 1 organizes these questions into a common framework; Figure 2 separates measurement, prediction and appraisal.
paragraph_edits.after: Whether overtime pay improves daily life depends on both the income gained and what it requires. Longer daytime work, repeated night shifts and greater efficiency with AI may all increase income, with different implications for sleep, energy and family time. Comparison begins with concrete questions: how much money is gained, where time goes, and whether the person can work, study or care for family the next day. Figure 1 brings these questions together; Figure 2 separates measurement, prediction and appraisal.

paragraph_edits.before: 这一问题可以从既有理论中找到清晰的起点。Grossman 将健康视为兼有消费与生产作用的资本存量，Becker 则把非市场时间纳入资源配置分析。[@E001][@E002] 马克思关于工作日的论述，将劳动时间、议价关系与劳动力再生产联系起来。[@E003] 三者分别强调健康存量、时间约束和劳动关系，为讨论健康代价提供了互补视角。沿着马克思的思路，可以追问生产收益与健康负担如何分配；但若要把某项健康损失归因于劳动安排，仍须识别具体暴露、替代方案及其结果。
paragraph_edits.after: 既有理论为这一问题提供了不同切入点。Grossman 将健康视为兼具消费与生产作用的资本存量，Becker 将非市场时间纳入资源配置分析。[@E001][@E002] 马克思对工作日的讨论，则将劳动时间、议价关系与劳动力再生产联系起来。[@E003] 这些理论分别关注健康、时间和劳动关系，不能彼此替代。沿着马克思的思路，可以追问生产收益与健康负担由谁承担；具体的健康损失仍须依据劳动暴露及其替代方案来识别，不能直接作为剩余价值的一项实测数量。

paragraph_edits.before: The starting point is established economics. Grossman's health-capital approach treats health as a stock relevant to both well-being and productive time; Becker's allocation-of-time framework makes non-market time part of economic choice. [@E001][@E002] Marx's discussion of the working day directs attention to bargaining, limits on labour and the reproduction of labour power. [@E003] These traditions motivate different questions rather than a single interchangeable theory. In particular, health losses cannot simply be appended to Marxian surplus value as an empirically measured quantity without a separate account of exposure, counterfactual outcomes and incidence.
paragraph_edits.after: Established theories offer different starting points. Grossman treats health as a stock with both consumption and production value; Becker brings non-market time into resource allocation. [@E001][@E002] Marx links the working day to bargaining and the reproduction of labour power. [@E003] These accounts address health, time and labour relations from distinct perspectives. Marx motivates questions about who receives production gains and who bears health burdens. Identifying a particular health loss still requires evidence about exposure and the feasible alternative; it cannot simply be added to surplus value as a measured quantity.

paragraph_edits.before: 健康可行能力理论关注的，不仅是已经实现的健康状态，还有人们维护健康、追求自身目标的真实机会。[@E004] 对于依赖加班收入支付住房或照护费用的人，拒绝加班的名义权利与实际能力可能相距甚远。健康状态也会影响收入对生活的意义，同额收入增量未必产生相同的福利改善。[@E005] 收入因此仍是重要资源，但其价值需要结合用途和约束来判断：它能否减轻困境，又以何种时间和健康代价换取。
paragraph_edits.after: 健康可行能力理论同时关注已经实现的健康状态，以及人们维护健康、追求自身目标的实际机会。[@E004] 对依赖加班收入支付住房或照护费用的人来说，有权拒绝加班，并不意味着有条件拒绝。健康状态也会改变收入对生活的意义，同额收入增量未必带来相同的福利改善。[@E005] 评价收入时，需要同时考察它缓解了哪些困难，以及为此付出的时间和健康代价。

paragraph_edits.before: Health capability approaches further distinguish achieved states from the real opportunities people have to maintain health and act on their goals. [@E004] This matters when an apparent choice cannot be refused without losing housing or essential care. Evidence on health-dependent utility also cautions against assuming that a given monetary increment has the same welfare significance in every health state. [@E005] Neither point makes income irrelevant. Resources can enable care, security and participation; the question is which consequences a particular increment enables or displaces under actual constraints.
paragraph_edits.after: Health capability concerns both achieved health and the real opportunities people have to maintain it and pursue their goals. [@E004] A person who needs overtime pay for housing or care may have the right to refuse without the means to do so. Health-dependent utility also means that the same income increment need not yield the same welfare gain in every health state. [@E005] Appraisal should therefore consider which difficulties the income relieves and the time and health costs of obtaining it.

paragraph_edits.before: 本文所称健康经济价值，是健康与功能变化在资源配置和个人选择中的意义。它既涉及健康本身，也涉及健康对日常活动和生活目标的支持。为使这一价值进入具体决策，本文提出健康后果比较框架：在相同期限内比较可行方案，分别列出收益、负担及其不确定性，再依据当事人的目标作出评价。比较可以形成明确选择，也可以揭示选择成立的条件，或保留尚无法排序的分歧。
paragraph_edits.after: 本文所称健康经济价值，是健康与功能变化对资源配置和个人选择的意义，包括健康本身的价值及其对日常活动的支持。它不等同于赚钱能力、总体福利或人的价值。比较框架据此列出可行方案，追踪后果随时间的变化，并结合证据、不确定性和个人目标作出判断。比较可以得到明确的选择，也可以说明某项选择在什么条件下成立，或哪些分歧暂时无法消解。

paragraph_edits.before: We use health economic value to mean the decision-relevant significance of health and functioning within these trade-offs. It is not synonymous with total welfare, earning capacity or a person's worth. Money, time, experience and agency enter the comparison because they interact with health and carry value of their own. The proposed contribution is an integrative accounting procedure: specify a feasible counterfactual, trace consequences over time, attach evidence and uncertainty, and make the evaluative judgement explicit. A legitimate result can be a preference, a conditional choice or an unresolved comparison.
paragraph_edits.after: We use health economic value to describe the significance of health and functioning for resource allocation and personal choice, including the value of health itself and its support for daily activities. It is distinct from earning capacity, total welfare and human worth. The framework specifies feasible alternatives, traces their consequences over time, and makes evidence, uncertainty and personal priorities explicit. A comparison may yield a preference, identify the conditions under which a choice is justified, or leave a disagreement unresolved.

paragraph_edits.before: 货币估值适用于特定的政策与资源配置问题，但补偿和恢复是两回事。补贴可以改善经济处境，却不据此证明功能损失已被弥补；某项损失难以逆转，也不妨碍比较预防、缓解和其他可行安排。尤其在备选机会有限时，接受补偿所反映的可能是生计约束，而不只是对健康风险的偏好。行为福利分析对选择条件的讨论，有助于说明为何实际选择不能无条件地代表充分知情的价值判断。[@E006]
paragraph_edits.after: 货币估值可用于特定的政策和资源配置问题，补偿支付却不能证明身体功能已经恢复。即使某项损失难以逆转，人们仍需比较预防、缓解和其他可行安排。接受补偿也有不同原因：有人认为收益足以抵偿风险，有人则缺少维持生计的其他选择。行为福利分析因此要求关注选择发生的条件，不能把所有实际选择都视为充分知情的价值判断。[@E006]

paragraph_edits.before: Monetary valuation can answer defined policy questions, but compensation is not biological restoration. Conversely, irreversibility does not logically make valuation impossible: people still compare prevention, mitigation and foregone opportunities. What fails is the inference that a payment necessarily neutralizes a loss. A stated minimum payment depends on income, alternatives and understanding; accepting dangerous work under severe deprivation does not establish that the health loss is trivial. Behavioural welfare analysis provides reasons to examine the conditions under which choices reveal evaluative preferences. [@E006]
paragraph_edits.after: Monetary valuation can inform defined policy and resource-allocation questions, but payment does not establish that lost functioning has been restored. Even when a loss is irreversible, people still compare prevention, mitigation and feasible alternatives. Acceptance of compensation can reflect a considered trade-off or a lack of other ways to meet essential needs. Behavioural welfare analysis therefore examines the conditions under which observed choices reveal informed preferences. [@E006]

paragraph_edits.before: 成本—后果分析将不同结果并列呈现，多准则决策分析则要求说明评价标准及其权重。[@E008][@E009] 成熟的决策指南也已包含备选方案、价值取向和支持需求。[@E010] 本文在这些方法基础上，突出四项容易在日常选择中遗漏的信息：时间重新分配到何处，结果如何随时间变化，有辅助与无辅助时的功能是否不同，以及收益和负担分别由谁承担。由此形成的比较记录见表 1。
paragraph_edits.after: 成本—后果分析将不同结果并列呈现，多准则决策分析则明确评价标准及其权重。[@E009][@E008] 成熟的决策指南也会询问备选方案、价值取向和支持需求。[@E010] 本文在这些方法上增加具体记录：节约的时间用在何处，结果能持续多久，有无辅助时的功能有何差别，以及收益和负担由谁承担。这些项目构成表 1 的比较记录，其实际作用仍需与既有工具比较验证。

paragraph_edits.before: The framework adapts the transparency of cost–consequence analysis and the explicit criteria of multicriteria decision analysis, while retaining their limitations. [@E008][@E009] It adds no validated universal scale. An established decision guide already elicits options, uncertainty, values and support needs. [@E010] Our narrower proposal makes time reallocation, outcome trajectories, assisted versus unaided functioning and the distribution of consequences explicit within such support. Any advantage over existing tools must be demonstrated, not inferred from a new label.
paragraph_edits.after: Cost–consequence analysis presents outcomes alongside one another, while multicriteria decision analysis makes criteria and weights explicit. [@E009][@E008] Established decision guides already elicit options, values and support needs. [@E010] Our proposal adds specific records of where saved time goes, how outcomes develop, how functioning differs with and without assistance, and who bears the consequences. Table 1 organizes these fields. Their usefulness must be tested against existing tools.

paragraph_edits.before: 比较框架追求的是记录规则的一致，而非偏好的一致。当收入、睡眠与家庭时间发生冲突时，首先应把冲突呈现出来，再考察不同优先目标会如何改变结论。汇总评分只有在量尺、权重和重复计量问题得到合理处理后才有解释力。对于缺少可靠换算关系的结果，分别报告往往更便于判断。
paragraph_edits.after: 比较需要统一记录规则，也需要容纳不同偏好。收入、睡眠与家庭时间发生冲突时，应先列明得失，再考察改变优先顺序是否会改变选择。只有在量尺、权重、不确定性和重复计量问题得到合理处理后，汇总评分才有解释力。缺少可靠换算关系的结果，可保留各自单位，分别报告。

paragraph_edits.before: Table 1 provides a minimum record. Its purpose is comparability of the decision process, not uniformity of preferences. When meaningful consequences diverge, the analyst should show the conflict and examine sensitivity to priorities. A single index is optional only when its scales, weights, uncertainty and double-counting risks are defensible; declining to aggregate is often the more informative result.
paragraph_edits.after: A common record should accommodate different priorities. When income, sleep and family time conflict, the comparison should show the trade-off and test whether changing priorities changes the choice. An overall score is interpretable only when scales, weights, uncertainty and double counting have been addressed. Outcomes without a defensible conversion can retain their own units and be reported separately.

paragraph_edits.before: 任务效率是最直接的评价层次。Noy 和 Zhang 对 453 名专业人士开展的随机研究显示，AI 辅助提高了写作速度与产出质量。[@E011] Brynjolfsson 等在涉及 5,172 名客服人员的现场研究中，利用分阶段部署进行双重差分分析，主分析显示每小时解决问题数约提高 15%。[@E026] 后者属于准实验研究，测量的是工作效率。这些结果说明 AI 可以提高生产率，但节约的时间如何分配、健康是否改善，还需要另外测量。 研究未掌握薪酬数据，生产率增益因而不能直接解释为劳动者收入增长。[@E026]
paragraph_edits.after: 任务效率是最直接的评价结果。Noy 和 Zhang 对 453 名专业人士开展的随机研究发现，AI 辅助提高了写作速度与产出质量。[@E011] Brynjolfsson 等研究了涉及 5,172 名客服人员的分阶段部署，双重差分主分析显示每小时解决问题数约提高 15%。[@E026] 后者属于准实验研究，测量的是工作效率，且未掌握薪酬数据。两项研究支持生产率收益，但节约的时间由谁支配、劳动者收入和健康是否改善，仍需另行测量。[@E026]

paragraph_edits.before: AI can expand productive capacity. In a randomized study of 453 professionals, Noy and Zhang found improvements in writing-task speed and quality. [@E011] In a field study covering 5,172 customer-support agents, Brynjolfsson and colleagues used staggered deployment and difference-in-differences analysis; their preferred estimate implied about a 15% increase in issues resolved per hour. [@E026] This was not a randomized trial, and the field outcome was throughput, not health. Together these studies support productivity gains while leaving open who receives the time or income dividend. The study lacked compensation data, so productivity gains cannot directly be interpreted as increased worker income. [@E026]
paragraph_edits.after: Task efficiency is the most direct outcome. Noy and Zhang found faster writing and better output in a randomized study of 453 professionals. [@E011] Brynjolfsson and colleagues examined a staggered rollout covering 5,172 customer-support agents; their main difference-in-differences estimate indicated about 15% more issues resolved per hour. [@E026] The latter study was quasi-experimental, measured throughput and lacked compensation data. These studies support productivity gains, but who controls the saved time, and whether income or health improves, require separate measurement. [@E026]

paragraph_edits.before: 第二个层次是能力变化。辅助条件下完成任务，与撤去辅助后独立完成任务，反映的是不同能力。Bastani 等的教育实验说明，仅观察辅助练习的成绩，难以判断学习效果，还需安排无辅助测评。[@E012] 对 AI 的评价因此应同时关注即时表现、独立表现和向陌生任务的迁移。工具支持本身也有价值：即使独立能力未变，原本难以完成的活动变得可及，仍可能改善日常生活。
paragraph_edits.after: 第二个层次是能力变化。辅助条件下完成任务，与撤去辅助后独立完成任务，需要分别测量。Bastani 等的教育实验说明，判断学习效果还需安排无辅助测评。[@E012] 评价应同时关注即时表现、独立表现和向陌生任务的迁移，不能据一项实验推断 AI 普遍损害认知。工具支持本身也有价值：即使独立能力未变，原本难以完成的活动变得可及，仍可能改善日常生活。

paragraph_edits.before: The relevant distinction is also between performance with assistance and capability retained without it. Bastani and colleagues' educational experiment illustrates why an evaluation should include an unaided assessment rather than infer learning from assisted practice alone. [@E012] This does not establish that AI generally erodes cognition. It specifies a measurement requirement: immediate performance, transfer to unfamiliar tasks and independent performance answer different questions. Accessibility and supported functioning can be valuable even where unaided performance is unchanged.
paragraph_edits.after: A second outcome is capability. Performance with assistance and performance after assistance is removed require separate measurement. Bastani and colleagues’ education experiment illustrates the need for an unaided assessment of learning. [@E012] Evaluation should cover immediate performance, independent performance and transfer to unfamiliar tasks; this experiment does not establish general cognitive harm from AI. Support itself also has value when it makes previously difficult activities accessible, even if unaided ability is unchanged.

paragraph_edits.before: 第三个层次是收益能否持续。De Freitas 等持续 7 天的第三项研究发现，AI 陪伴带来的孤独感缓解主要体现于互动后的即时测量，尚未证明互动前的孤独水平持续下降。[@E013] 组间退出差异、对照组互动时长不匹配，也限制了结果解释。即时安慰值得被记录，而长期收益需通过后续测量判断。短内容与虚拟互动同样应考察愉悦、睡眠、人际联系和自主退出等具体结果，单凭使用时长难以确定其价值。
paragraph_edits.after: 第三个层次是收益的持续时间。De Freitas 等持续 7 天的第三项研究中，AI 陪伴带来的孤独缓解主要出现在互动后的即时测量，尚未证明互动前的孤独水平持续下降。[@E013] 组间退出差异和对照时长不匹配限制了结果解释。评价既应记录即时安慰，也应随访效果是否持续。对于短内容和虚拟互动，还可观察愉悦、睡眠、人际联系和能否自主结束使用；活动名称或使用时长本身不足以确定其价值。

paragraph_edits.before: AI companionship raises a temporal distinction. In the seven-day third study reported by De Freitas and colleagues, loneliness relief was most clearly immediate; a persistent improvement in pre-interaction loneliness was not demonstrated. [@E013] Differential attrition and a non-time-matched control limit interpretation. This is evidence for examining when benefit occurs, not grounds for dismissing companionship or diagnosing dependence. For short-form content and virtual interaction, useful records would include sleep displacement, enjoyment, relationships and the ability to disengage; content type or duration alone does not establish harm.
paragraph_edits.after: A third outcome is how long a benefit lasts. In De Freitas and colleagues’ seven-day Study 3, loneliness relief appeared mainly in immediate post-interaction measures; persistent improvement before interaction was not demonstrated. [@E013] Differential attrition and an unmatched control duration limit interpretation. Evaluation should record immediate comfort and follow whether it lasts. For short-form content and virtual interaction, relevant outcomes also include enjoyment, sleep, relationships and the ability to stop. Activity labels or duration alone do not establish their value.

paragraph_edits.before: 医疗建议体现了从信息到行动的另一道距离。Bean 等发现，使用者处理假设医疗场景时，未能达到模型单独作答的表现；图 5d 列出其对照组与 AI 辅助组的识别结果。[@E014] 这里测量的是场景判断，并非真实患病结局。停用 Facebook 的研究也提示，应关注平台使用之外的生活变化，但其结果不能直接作为生成式 AI 的效应。[@E015] 近期关于健康素养导向 AI 的讨论强调理解、自主性、责任和相称性。[@E024] 将任务表现、持续能力和生活结果分开评价，有助于把这些要求落实到可观察的指标上。

paragraph_edits.before: Information accuracy and user benefit also differ. Bean and colleagues found that people working through hypothetical medical scenarios did not reproduce the models' standalone performance; Figure 5d retains the reported control-versus-AI contrast. [@E014] The outcome was scenario interpretation, not clinical disease. Earlier Facebook-deactivation research likewise shows the value of measuring consequences beyond platform use, although social-media findings cannot simply be transferred to generative AI. [@E015] Health-literate AI already emphasizes comprehension, agency, accountability and proportionality. [@E024] Our proposal complements that agenda by specifying the consequences and time horizons to compare, rather than claiming these concerns as new.
paragraph_edits.after: Medical advice also raises the question of how information becomes action. Bean and colleagues found that users handling hypothetical medical scenarios did not match the models’ standalone performance; Figure 5d shows identification in the control group relative to pooled AI assistance. [@E014] This measures scenario judgement, not clinical disease. Facebook-deactivation research likewise examines life beyond platform use, although its findings cannot directly establish generative AI effects. [@E015] Health-literate AI emphasizes comprehension, agency, accountability and proportionality. paragraph_edits.before: For the decision tool, an active comparator is essential. Both groups should receive the same factual evidence and an established guide; the intervention adds the explicit time, consequence and uncertainty module (Fig. 10). Decision-quality research and the Cochrane review of patient decision aids inform the comparator and outcome selection. [@E021][@E022] The primary outcome should be specified before recruitment, with independent scoring of understanding rather than agreement with the author's preferred lifestyle. Transfer to an unfamiliar decision, values–choice concordance and calibrated uncertainty can be secondary outcomes.
paragraph_edits.after: Tool evaluation should use an active comparator: identical evidence and an established guide, with only the intervention group receiving the added record of time, consequences and uncertainty. Decision-quality research and the Cochrane review inform comparator and outcome selection. [@E021][@E022] Prespecify understanding as a potential primary outcome with independent scoring; transfer, values–choice concordance and calibrated uncertainty can be secondary outcomes.

paragraph_edits.before: 使用负担也应纳入评价，包括完成时间、退出、焦虑和可及性，并保留停止使用者的反馈。方案需预先说明目标效应、样本量依据、缺失数据和多重比较的处理。若新增模块未改善理解，或负担超过收益，就应简化或调整。评价标准在于决策质量，而非参与者是否作出了研究者偏好的选择。
paragraph_edits.after: 还需记录完成时间、退出、焦虑、可及性和停止使用者的体验。重复使用可能带来学习、疲劳或决策变化。预注册方案应说明目标人群、目标效应、样本量依据、缺失数据和多重比较处理。访谈可以解释理解或分歧，不能替代因果估计。若新增记录未带来实质收益，或负担超过收益，应简化或停止使用；选择更符合研究者的生活偏好，不能作为成功标准。

paragraph_edits.before: Evaluation must also capture completion time, attrition, anxiety, accessibility and the experience of people who stop using the tool. Repeated use may introduce learning, fatigue or changes in the decision itself. A preregistered protocol should specify the target population, effect of interest, analysis of missingness, multiplicity and sample-size justification. Interviews can explain comprehension or disagreement but cannot replace causal estimates. If the added module offers no meaningful benefit over the guide, or its burden outweighs benefit, it should be simplified or abandoned; a shift toward supposedly healthier choices alone would not demonstrate success.
paragraph_edits.after: Record completion time, attrition, anxiety, accessibility and withdrawals’ experiences. Repeated use may bring learning, fatigue or changed decisions. Preregister the population, target effect, sample-size basis, missing-data analysis and multiplicity handling. Interviews can explain understanding or disagreement, but cannot replace causal estimates. Simplify or discontinue a module without meaningful net benefit. Choices closer to the researchers’ preferred lifestyle alone do not establish success.

principles: Preserve evidence identifiers and effect estimates
